digest.component_or_area: Automated bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-bug filing)
propositions: Automated bug filers spam duplicates and file single flakes due to missing dedup logic, stable tags, and consecutive-red thresholds.
Heartbeat-alert filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold via workflow run-history query without introducing a new state store.
All three auto-bug-filing sites require templated bug bodies with required fields (check name, first-red time, run URL, failing-output tail, workflow path) and abort-if-empty logic.
Bug-creation contract must be documented with exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search commands, and detected_by environment variable usage.

Conflict-bug filer requires per-conflict sha1 dedup tag, daily accumulation comment limit via marker-line detection in ticket comment history, and detected_by stamping; auto-close is not retrofitted (rationale: needs adjudication).
